---
name: "Register Claim"
description: "Turn a proposed research finding into a calibrated claim-ledger entry before analysis or publication."
argument-hint: "Proposed finding and intended scope"
agent: "research-lead"
tools: [read, edit, search]
---

Read `research/claims.yml` and the selected research question. Add or revise one
claim with a stable ID, precise statement, calibrated status, scope, evaluator or
proof requirement, tolerance where relevant, evidence paths, limitations, and
publication visibility. Do not implement the analysis in this task. Report the
cheapest check that could falsify the registered statement.
